rules.description: Database clients, schema, query builders, and raw SQL stay inside named backend ownership roots.
Durable job-table queries are limited to database definitions, migrations, and the exact PostgreSQL job adapter.
Dedicated Company Identity persistence is reachable only from its database module and backend PostgreSQL adapter.
Company Identity tables and migrations remain outside education schemas, migrations, and tenant registries.
AI provider SDKs and client construction stay inside the AI provider adapter directory.
Object-storage provider SDKs and client construction stay inside the storage driver directory.
External integration SDKs and direct clients stay inside explicitly named integration driver directories.

ownershipRoots.rationale: The database package owns schema definitions, clients, migrations helpers, and low-level persistence primitives.
Database schema modules own durable job table definitions but do not run worker polling loops.
Reviewed Drizzle migrations may define and evolve PostgreSQL-owned tables, including durable job tables.
Database-owned maintenance commands may inspect migration state through low-level PostgreSQL connections.
Existing transport-independent domain functions are an approved database orchestration boundary during incremental migration.
Capability handlers and backend modules may use scoped database ports under the canonical backend architecture.
This exact PostgreSQL adapter is the only query root outside database definitions and migrations for durable job tables.
The dedicated Company Identity database module owns its schema, migration commands, and low-level client.
The exact backend PostgreSQL adapter implements Company Identity ports without exposing persistence to product apps.
The dedicated Company Identity migration directory owns Drizzle configuration and reviewed identity migration artifacts.
AI provider implementations normalize vendor calls behind the provider-neutral AI client interface.
Storage drivers normalize S3-compatible provider behavior behind the provider-neutral storage client.
GitHub driver implementations own direct provider calls behind the repository integration interface.

exactExceptions.rationale: This exact adapter test imports AWS command types to verify normalized S3 driver behavior.
This exact contract test injects AWS failures to prove provider errors do not cross the adapter boundary.
